title: Pure Transcendosaurus
summary: Transcendosaurus is a Level 6 and Level 12 Dinosaur multi-Extra-Deck (Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link) strategy centered around Ground Xeno, Xeno Meteorus, Normal Monster Dinosaurs, and the classic Dinosaur destruction engine.

summary.title: Starters
points: Souleating Oviraptor (searchable via Fossil Dig) adds or sends any Dinosaur monster (Babycerasaurus, Miscellaneousaurus, or Xeno Meteorus) from the Deck to the hand or GY on Normal or Special Summon.
Ground Xeno searches any Dinosaur Tuner (Xeno Meteorus) or Dinosaur Normal Monster (Frostosaurus or Megalosmasher X), then destroys 1 card in your hand (triggering Babycerasaurus and Xeno Meteorus).

Miscellaneousaurus discards itself to make your Dinosaurs on the field unaffected by the opponent's activated effects during the Main Phase, then banishes itself from the GY to Special Summon Animadorned Archosaur from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Souleating Oviraptor + Babycerasaurus (or Ground Xeno + Babycerasaurus)
steps: Activate Ground Xeno to search Xeno Meteorus and destroy Babycerasaurus in your hand; Babycerasaurus Special Summons Souleating Oviraptor from the Deck, while Xeno Meteorus triggers in the hand to Special Summon itself.

Oviraptor searches another Babycerasaurus (or Miscellaneousaurus), and Xeno Meteorus destroys a Babycerasaurus to Special Summon Level 6 Normal Monster Frostosaurus from the Deck (while Babycerasaurus summons Animadorned Archosaur to search Double Evolution Pill).

Tune Level 6 Xeno Meteorus and Level 6 Frostosaurus into Level 12 Transcendosaurus Glaciasaurus (or overlay them into Rank 6 Evolzar Lars), then banish Ground Xeno from the GY to Fusion Summon Level 12 Transcendosaurus Gigantozowler using Frostosaurus and a Dinosaur.

summary.title: Normal Monster Self-Revival Loop
summary.text: Every Level 12 and Extra Deck Transcendosaurus boss—Transcendosaurus Meteorus, Gigantozowler, Glaciasaurus, Drillygnathus, and Exaraptor—shares a signature recursion clause: if destroyed, you can shuffle 1 Normal Monster (Frostosaurus or Megalosmasher X) from your GY into the Deck to immediately Special Summon that Transcendosaurus from your GY. When Gigantozowler revives from the GY this way, its effect upgrades to both recycle a Dinosaur from the GY AND destroy 1 card in your hand/field and 1 card your opponent controls.

summary.title: Bosses & Disruption
points: Transcendosaurus Gigantozowler (3800 ATK Fusion) recovers a Dinosaur from the GY on summon and pops an opponent's card when revived from the GY; Transcendosaurus Glaciasaurus (3200 ATK Synchro) prevents your GY-summoned Dinosaurs from being targeted or destroyed by opponent's card effects.

Transcendosaurus Meteorus (3500 ATK Main Deck boss) destroys 2 Dinosaurs in your hand/field as a Quick Effect on the opponent's turn to Special Summon itself and send a Dinosaur from the Deck to the GY.

Evolzar Lars (Rank 6 from Xeno Meteorus + Frostosaurus, or stacked over Rank 4 Transcendosaurus Drillygnathus) negates face-up opponent's cards, Evolzar Dolkka negates monster effects twice per turn, and Ultimate Conductor Tyranno (summoned via Double Evolution Pill) flips the opponent's board face-down.

summary.title: Spells
points: Ground Xeno both starts the combo by popping Babycerasaurus in the hand and banishes itself from the GY during the Main Phase to Fusion Summon Transcendosaurus Gigantozowler using materials from your hand or field.

Fossil Dig searches any Level 6 or lower Dinosaur (covering Xeno Meteorus, Oviraptor, Miscellaneousaurus, and Babycerasaurus), and Double Evolution Pill banishes 1 Dinosaur and 1 non-Dinosaur from the hand/GY to cheat out Ultimate Conductor Tyranno or Transcendosaurus Meteorus from the Deck.

allow.Xeno Meteorus: Core Level 6 FIRE Dinosaur Tuner of the Transcendosaurus engine: Special Summons itself from your hand whenever a card is destroyed by battle or card effect, then destroys 1 Dinosaur monster in your hand or field to Special Summon 1 Dinosaur Normal Monster (Level 6 Frostosaurus or Level 4 Megalosmasher X!) directly from your hand or Deck!
allow.Souleating Oviraptor: Core Level 4 Dinosaur starter that searches or dumps Babycerasaurus, Xeno Meteorus, or Transcendosaurus Exaraptor on Normal or Special Summon.
allow.Miscellaneousaurus: Limited to 1 in TCG: discards itself to make all your Dinosaurs unaffected by your opponent's activated effects during the Main Phase, and banishes Dinosaurs from GY to summon Animadorned Archosaur or Babycerasaurus from the Deck.
allow.Babycerasaurus: Level 2 Dinosaur that Special Summons Souleating Oviraptor from your Deck whenever destroyed by Ground Xeno, Xeno Meteorus, or Transcendosaurus Meteorus!
allow.Animadorned Archosaur: Level 1 Dinosaur summoned by Miscellaneousaurus that destroys Babycerasaurus in your hand or field to search Double Evolution Pill (and trigger Xeno Meteorus in hand!).
allow.Frostosaurus: Level 6 WATER Dinosaur Normal Monster (2600 ATK): Special Summoned directly from your Deck by Xeno Meteorus—pairing with Level 6 Tuner Xeno Meteorus for Level 12 Synchro Transcendosaurus Glaciasaurus or Rank 6 Evolzar Lars, and sitting in your GY so every Level 12 Transcendosaurus boss can shuffle it back into the Deck to revive itself when destroyed!
allow.Megalosmasher X: Level 4 WATER Dinosaur Normal Monster (2000 ATK): Special Summoned from your Deck by Xeno Meteorus to pair with Level 4 Oviraptor for Rank 4 Transcendosaurus Drillygnathus or fuse via Ground Xeno into Transcendosaurus Gigantozowler!
allow.Ultimate Conductor Tyranno: Level 10 Dinosaur boss summoned via Double Evolution Pill that destroys a Dinosaur in hand/field to flip all opponent's monsters face-down.
allow.Double Evolution Pill: Searched by Animadorned Archosaur to Special Summon Transcendosaurus Meteorus or Ultimate Conductor Tyranno directly from your hand or Deck.
allow.Evolzar Lars: Rank 6 Dragon Xyz (summoned using Level 6 Xeno Meteorus + Level 6 Frostosaurus, or using 1 Dinosaur Xyz like Drillygnathus!) that detaches 1 material to negate any face-up card your opponent controls.
allow.Evolzar Dolkka: Rank 4 Dragon Xyz (2 Level 4 Dinosaurs: Oviraptor + Megalosmasher X) that negates monster effects twice per turn.

main: Xeno Meteorus

Core Level 6 FIRE Dinosaur Tuner: if a card(s) is destroyed by battle or card effect, Special Summons itself from your hand; during your Main Phase, destroys 1 Dinosaur monster in your hand or face-up field (like Babycerasaurus!) to Special Summon 1 Dinosaur Normal Monster (Level 6 Frostosaurus or Level 4 Megalosmasher X!) directly from your hand or Deck!
Transcendosaurus Meteorus

Signature Level 12 DARK Dinosaur Main Deck boss (3500 ATK): during your opponent's turn, if this card is in your hand (Quick Effect), destroys 2 other Dinosaur monsters in your hand and/or face-up field to Special Summon itself; when Special Summoned, sends 1 Dinosaur from your Deck to the GY; and if destroyed, shuffles 1 Normal Monster from your GY into the Deck to revive itself!
Souleating Oviraptor
Core Level 4 starter: adds or sends any Dinosaur monster (Babycerasaurus, Xeno Meteorus, or Frostosaurus) from your Deck to your hand/GY on Normal or Special Summon.
Miscellaneousaurus
Limited to 1 in TCG: makes all your Dinosaurs unaffected by your opponent's activated effects during the Main Phase, and banishes itself from GY to summon Animadorned Archosaur from your Deck.
Babycerasaurus
Mandatory trigger when destroyed by Ground Xeno, Xeno Meteorus, Archosaur, or Gigantozowler and sent to the GY: Special Summons any Level 4 or lower Dinosaur from your Deck!
Animadorned Archosaur
Destroys Babycerasaurus in your hand or field (triggering Xeno Meteorus in hand!) to search Double Evolution Pill.
Frostosaurus

Level 6 WATER Dinosaur Normal Monster (2600 ATK): summoned from your Deck by Xeno Meteorus to make Level 12 Transcendosaurus Glaciasaurus or Rank 6 Evolzar Lars, and shuffled from your GY into the Deck to revive any destroyed Transcendosaurus boss!
Megalosmasher X
Level 4 WATER Dinosaur Normal Monster (2000 ATK): summoned from your Deck by Xeno Meteorus to overlay into Rank 4 Transcendosaurus Drillygnathus or fuse into Gigantozowler.
Ultimate Conductor Tyranno
Level 10 Dinosaur boss summoned via Double Evolution Pill that flips opposing boards face-down.
Ground Xeno

Core Normal Spell: adds ANY Dinosaur Tuner (Xeno Meteorus!) OR any Dinosaur Normal Monster (Frostosaurus/Megalosmasher X) from your Deck to your hand, then destroys 1 card in your hand (Babycerasaurus!); and banishes itself from your GY during your Main Phase to Fusion Summon Transcendosaurus Gigantozowler!
Fossil Dig
Adds any Level 6 or lower Dinosaur (Xeno Meteorus, Souleating Oviraptor, Miscellaneousaurus, or Babycerasaurus!) from your Deck to your hand.
Double Evolution Pill
Banishes 1 Dinosaur and 1 non-Dinosaur from your hand/GY to Special Summon Transcendosaurus Meteorus or Ultimate Conductor Tyranno directly from your Deck.
extra: Signature Level 12 EARTH Dinosaur Fusion boss (1 Dinosaur monster + 1 Normal Monster; 3800 ATK; summoned via Ground Xeno's GY effect!): when Special Summoned, adds 1 Dinosaur monster from your GY to your hand—and if Special Summoned from the GY, also destroys 1 card in your hand/field (Babycerasaurus!) and 1 card your opponent controls; if destroyed, shuffles 1 Normal Monster from your GY into the Deck to immediately Special Summon itself from your GY!

Signature Level 12 WATER Dinosaur Synchro boss (1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners: Level 6 Xeno Meteorus + Level 6 Frostosaurus; 3200 ATK): cannot be destroyed by battle, and Dinosaur monsters you control that were Special Summoned from the GY cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects or targeted by them; if destroyed, shuffles 1 Normal Monster from your GY into the Deck to immediately Special Summon itself!

Signature Rank 4 WIND Dinosaur Xyz (2 Level 4 monsters; 3000 ATK): detaches 1 material to Special Summon 1 banished Dinosaur monster; inflicts DOUBLE battle damage when battling a monster while it has no Xyz Material; and shuffles 1 Normal Monster from GY into the Deck if destroyed to revive itself!

Signature Link-3 DARK Dinosaur (2+ Level 6 or higher monsters; 3000 ATK): Special Summons 1 Dinosaur monster from your hand on Special Summon; draws 1 card if a face-up Dinosaur(s) it points to is destroyed by battle or sent to the GY; and shuffles 1 Normal Monster from GY into the Deck if destroyed to revive itself!

Rank 6 Dragon Xyz (summoned using Level 6 Xeno Meteorus + Level 6 Frostosaurus, OR by overlaying directly on top of Rank 4 Transcendosaurus Drillygnathus!) that detaches 1 material to negate any face-up card your opponent controls!
Rank 4 Dragon Xyz (Oviraptor + Megalosmasher X) that negates monster effects twice per turn.
